name: ELRIDGE
recent: Elridge Energy 在2026年11月23日发布季度业绩，第三季净利按年增长43%，主要受棕榈仁壳销售增强带动。公司同时宣布与多方签署谅解备忘录，并于10月投资4500万令吉进军活性炭下游业务。此外，执行董事兼首席执行官Yeoh Hock Cheong在10月多次增持公司股份。
notable: 执行董事兼首席执行官Yeoh Hock Cheong在10月多次增持公司股份。
公司投资4500万令吉进军活性炭下游业务。
earnings: 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为1.317亿令吉，按年增长26.5%，按季增长0.7%；净利为2219万令吉，按年增长78.5%，按季增长24.8%；净利率为16.8%，高于上一季度的13.6%。

recent_en: Elridge Energy released its quarterly results on 23 Nov 2026, with 3Q net profit rising 43% year-on-year on stronger palm kernel shell sales. The company also signed a memorandum of understanding and invested RM45 million in October to venture into downstream activated carbon. Executive Director and CEO Yeoh Hock Cheong acquired shares multiple times in October.
notable_en: Signed a memorandum of understanding (23 Nov 2026).
Executive Director and CEO Yeoh Hock Cheong acquired shares multiple times in October.
The company invested RM45 million to venture into downstream activated carbon.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM131.7 million, up 26.5% year-on-year and 0.7% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM22.19 million, up 78.5% year-on-year and 24.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 16.8%, higher than 13.6% in the previous quarter.
